goal.title: Check that no other client has this rejection
goal.concept: A boolean query joins conditions with and, or and not. Asking for what shouldn't exist turns an empty result into evidence.
goal.narration: One event pairs the reason with a client. Check that the reason comes from no other client: in the query bar, ask for the reason and not that client, joining the two conditions with and not. No results means it happens nowhere else.
goal.reasoning: One event shows the reason and the client together, but not that every such rejection comes from that client. A query for the reason from any other client tests exactly that.
goal.evidence: The query finds nothing, so the reason occurs only with that client.

demonstration.evidence: No results: no ${param.incident.reason} rejection in the window came from any client other than ${param.incident.client}. Here the empty result is the evidence. ${truth.conclusion}
